Name: CP Willy's Portrait - LFL Compatible
Author: CuntressSupreme
Description:
Content Patcher Portrait for Willy.  Please keep in mind that if you have any other mod that alters Willy's portrait (e.g. Seasonal Outfits), you might have to delete or replace all of his portraits in that mod with this one for it to work. 


This is [u]not[/u] my own art. You can find the original post [url=https://gall.dcinside.com/mgallery/board/view/?id=stardew&no=41596&exception_mode=recommend&s_type=search_all&s_keyword=%EA%B5%B0%ED%84%B0&page=1#focus_cmt]here.[/url] The original artist has deleted their profile, and in the post, permission is granted for redistribution. I'm posting this here for easier access and in the hopes that it reaches a wider audience, as i really like the art. All credits go to the unfortunately unnamed artist. If you know the artist has revoked permission for redistribution, please let me know!

Downloads.DisplayName: Willy Portrait - LFL Compatible - intended for 1.5
Downloads.Description:
to use with LFL: copy and paste the png at:
Mods\Looking For Love\[CP] Looking for Love\[CP] Looking for Love\assets\Portraits

and make sure that the name of the new portrait is the same as the one you're replacing.
